cells.title: Read a Windows delete-pending lock as busy in the split lock
cells.action: In split_lock::try_acquire add a cfg(windows) match arm: Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::PermissionDenied => Ok(false), placed after the AlreadyExists arm (per D1). No comment in code; the why is D1. Nothing else changes.
cells.verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee herding::split_lock

truths: try_acquire returns Ok(false) on a Windows PermissionDenied and the split_lock tests stay green on Linux
prohibitions: Do not widen the arm beyond PermissionDenied

cells.title: Poll for the deferred switch in the Pi marker fixture
cells.action: In the embedded harness JS add case "await_switches" beside await_messages: poll switches.length until call.count or call.timeout_ms, push step({switches_seen}). Add fn await_switches_step(count) -> Value using positive_wait_ms() beside await_injections_in_vain. In shell_tool_result_captures_marker_and_agent_settled_submits_private_command replace sleep_step(50) with await_switches_step(1) (per D2). Other fixtures unchanged.
cells.verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts shell_tool_result_captures_marker

truths: the harness has an await_switches step and the marker fixture uses it with the positive-wait window
prohibitions: Do not change the fixture's assertions
